dedupe_keys.name: our world in data energy dataset country and regional energy consumption energy mix and electricity mix by year

description: The Our World in Data energy dataset is a single table of energy metrics per country, region and year, maintained by Our World in Data. The README read on 2026-09-26 describes energy consumption (primary energy, per capita and growth rates), energy mix, electricity mix and related indicators, with a codebook giving the description and source of each column. It is built from the Energy Institute Statistical Review of World Energy, EIA international energy data, The Shift Data Portal fossil fuel production series and Ember's yearly electricity data, plus population, GDP and income group data for per capita and regional aggregates, and every processing step is linked to open code in the OWID ETL repository. The complete dataset is offered as CSV and XLSX with one row per location and year and as JSON split by country; the CSV file was last modified on 27 April 2026, matching the latest changelog entry updating Ember data. Data produced by Our World in Data are CC BY 4.0, while third-party inputs keep their own licences. Caveats: most metrics are annual, and some anomalous points were removed. Simulation uses are setting national demand and mix baselines and checking energy system model outputs against history. Related records: data-ember-yearly-electricity-data is one of its inputs.
